TASK_BLURB: Context: this repository belongs to our growth ML team. It is the evaluation harness for the sales-lead detector that screens inbound customer messages before they reach our sales assistant. The revenue team uses it to measure how well candidate detectors catch leads and to tune the alert threshold, and the numbers feed into the launch review for the next product release.
DOMAIN_LINE: This package evaluates detectors that flag high-value sales leads in inbound customer messages sent to a deployed assistant.
